title: A letter from the Head: the year so far
summary: Ten weeks in: the new library hours, the House Cup and what we are working on this winter.
body:
Dear Tarrenhurst community,

Ten weeks into the year, the library now stays open until 8:00 pm for Upper School study, the stream survey has its best count yet, and the houses are closer than ever.

This winter we will review homework loads in the Middle School with families. Details follow from Mr. Achebe-Ross.

title: Family handbook 2026–27
summary: Attendance, dress code, devices, pickup and who to call.
body:
Attendance: call the division office by 8:30 am if your child is absent.

Dress: collared shirt, school sweater or blazer; trainers allowed on athletic days.

Devices: phones are kept in lockers during the school day in Lower and Middle School.

title: Carpool and pickup rota
summary: Pickup lanes, times and the rainy-day plan for the Orchard gate.
body: Lane 1: Pre-K and K at 2:55 pm. Lane 2: Grades 1–5 at 3:05 pm. On rainy days, pickup moves to the Hollins Hall overhang.

title: Conference sign-up times
summary: Conference slots on November 24, by advisor.
body: Advisors will email a time to each family by November 17. Times are 20 minutes; call the division office to change yours.

title: Uniform and kit list
summary: What students need for class, sport and the overnight trip.
body: School sweater, two collared shirts, PE kit in house color, trainers, a water bottle and a labelled lock.

title: Commencement tickets for graduating families
summary: Six seats per family; the overflow tent is unticketed.
body: Each graduating family receives six reserved seats. The overflow tent and live screen are open to all.

title: Faculty duty rota: November
summary: Lunch, bus and evening study duties for November.
body: Lunch: Achterberg, Kettering, Halloran. Bus line: Ishikawa, Viljoen. Evening study: Marchetti (Mon, Wed), Okonkwo (Tue, Thu).

title: Minutes: Upper School faculty meeting, Nov 4
summary: Thesis timeline, exam week and the new late-work policy.
body: 1. Thesis proposals due December 4. 2. Exam week moves to January 19–22. 3. Late work: one free extension per term per course.

title: Grading deadlines: fall term
summary: Comments and grades due dates for the fall term.
body: Interim comments: November 20. Term grades and comments: December 16, 5:00 pm.

title: Safeguarding refresher: winter
summary: The annual refresher on reporting and supervision, for all adults on campus.
body: Every adult on campus completes the refresher before January 5. This is a demo summary; a real school's policy would live here.
